tools.description: Creates a test payment in the sandbox, through the person's test cashbox: kind "invoice" — a test invoice to payer_phone (status PENDING, then WAITING_FOR_PAYER a few seconds later), or "link" — a test payment link (QR_TOKEN_CREATED, lives 5 minutes). No money moves and Kaspi is not reached; end it with simulate_test_payment. Answers the payment in the fields of list_payments — id, status, amount, qr_token (for a link, the page a payer opens; null for an invoice), … — and, for a link, expire_date. Live payments are never created through this server. The sandbox's test payments, outcomes and test refunds through these tools are limited per person (60 a minute, 1000 a day): over it RATE_LIMITED with retry_after in seconds. environment is required and must be "sandbox".

tools.description: Creates a webhook subscription: xPayment POSTs the chosen events to url, signed with the subscription's secret (X-xPayment-Signature: the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body). events left out = every event. On live the subscription is the organization's and its secret never passes through this conversation: the answer is subscription, reveal_url — a one-time page where the person, signed in to the cabinet, sees the secret (it is made when they open it, and deliveries are signed with it from then on) — and expires_at (an hour). events.description: the events to deliver: payment.completed, payment.expired, payment.cancelled, payment.failed, payment.refunded, payment.refund_failed, booking.confirmed, booking.expired, booking.cancelled, booking.rescheduled, or "*" for all; left out = all

tools.description: Refunds a paid payment (COMPLETED or PARTIALLY_REFUNDED), in full or in part. On live this returns REAL MONEY to the payer through Kaspi and cannot be undone: tell the person the payment and the amount, ask them in this conversation and call with confirmed: true only after an explicit yes; without it the tool refuses and says what it would do. The same refund (the same payment and amount) again within ten minutes is refused as DUPLICATE_ACTION — after a lost answer, check get_payment instead of calling again. In the sandbox it is a test refund, needs no confirmed, and is limited with the other test traffic (RATE_LIMITED, retry_after); a test refund of exactly 13.13 is declined. The refund completes within seconds to minutes; get_payment shows it. Answers the refund: id, status (PENDING at first), amount, reason, created_at, completed_at. environment is required: "sandbox" or "live".
